purpose: Deterministic item-level queue for converting OCIN / BOOK from inventoried folders into agent-searchable KODEX sources without moving, overwriting or publishing originals.

truth.completionRule: Do not declare complete until pendingVisualAnalysis is 0 and every item has rights, semantic identity, relation classification and receiver recipe.

safeguards: Original Drive IDs are immutable references.
Duplicates remain registered as DUPLICATE_ASSET; do not delete physical files.
Creator ownership never implies automatic publication.
Cultural material requires community, source, context and authorization status.
Scientific claims must remain separate from metaphor.
A=THRESHOLD, M=HEART/0 optional, Y=RETURN/+∞; do not invent other letter meanings.
